The merge computes the second task vector against the already-modified tensor: it sets `tmp = b + λ(f1 - b)` and then adds `λ * (f2 - tmp)` instead of `λ * (f2 - b)`, which yields `b + λ(f1-b) + λ(f2-b) - λ²(f1-b)`, not the formula in Required result step 2. This is exactly the ordering hazard the specification warns about (each task vector must be taken against the unmodified base), and the resulting merged tensors will differ from the reference by more than the 1e-5 relative Frobenius tolerance whenever ft1 differs from base. Everything else (shared-tensor verification, 48/160 count checks, base tensors unchanged, output path) matches the specification.
